reader_summary.headline: Today, we will be breaking down Calm.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we will be breaking down Calm. Founded in 2012, Calm is the leading app for sleep and meditation. In this Breakdown, we touch on how Calm used data to unlock a non-obvious source of demand. To break down Calm, I am joined by my brother, Vinny Pujji, Partner at Left Lane Capital, an early-stage investment firm.
